skill.name: firebase-hosting-basics
skill.description: Guides agents through Firebase Hosting Classic setup, firebase.json configuration, local emulation, preview channels, and deployment. Use it for static sites, SPAs, or simple services, not Firebase App Hosting.
skill.summary: Guides Firebase Hosting Classic configuration, emulation, previews, and deployment for static sites, SPAs, and simple services.
skill.author: firebase

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 35 is a markdown heading with inline code for firebase.json, not shell or Ruby execution. No command is present on that line.

content.value_statement: Firebase Hosting setup can be confusing when choosing between classic Hosting, App Hosting, and deployment channels. This skill guides agents through configuration, local emulation, preview channels, and safe releases for static sites, SPAs, and simple services.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Firebase Hosting instead of Firebase App Hosting.
Guides firebase.json setup for public directories, rewrites, redirects, headers, clean URLs, and trailing slash behavior.
Shows local Hosting emulation with the Firebase CLI.
Describes live deploys, preview channel deploys, channel expiration, and cloning a preview to live.
Covers Hosting support for static sites, SPAs, Cloud Functions, and Cloud Run rewrites.
limitations: It covers Firebase Hosting Classic only, not Firebase App Hosting.
It provides guidance, not account setup, authentication, billing, or project provisioning.
It uses Firebase CLI examples and assumes the CLI can run in the user's environment.
It does not validate production security headers or application code.

use_cases.title: Launch a Static Site
use_cases.description: Deploy an HTML, CSS, and JavaScript site to Firebase Hosting with a clear public directory setup.

use_cases.title: Preview an SPA Release
use_cases.description: Create a preview channel for a React, Vue, or similar SPA before promoting changes.

use_cases.title: Route Dynamic Requests
use_cases.description: Plan Hosting rewrites that send selected paths to Cloud Functions or Cloud Run services.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Hosting Type
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me decide whether my project should use Firebase Hosting or Firebase App Hosting. My app is: [describe app].

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Firebase Hosting configuration plan for a static site with public directory [directory] and clean URLs [true or false].

prompt_templates.title: Add SPA and Header Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Hosting needs and recommend redirects, rewrites, headers, clean URLs, and trailing slash settings for this SPA.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Preview-to-Live Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Firebase Hosting release flow using preview channels, expiration, and cloning to live for project [project id].

output_examples.input: I need to deploy a Vite app from dist.
output_examples.output: A concise Hosting setup plan that names dist as the public directory, recommends local emulation, and lists deployment checks.

output_examples.input: I want to test a feature before live release.
output_examples.output: A preview-channel workflow with channel naming, expiration guidance, and promotion steps.

output_examples.input: My SPA routes return not found after refresh.
output_examples.output: A rewrite recommendation that routes unmatched paths to the app shell and preserves API paths.

best_practices: Test locally with the Hosting emulator before every production deploy.
Use preview channels for review links before cloning or deploying to live.
Keep Hosting rewrites, redirects, headers, and public paths explicit in firebase.json.
anti_patterns: Using Firebase Hosting for SSR apps that should use Firebase App Hosting.
Deploying directly to live without a preview channel or local emulator check.
Leaving routing, cache, and header behavior undocumented in the Hosting configuration.

faq.question: Does this skill support Firebase App Hosting?
faq.answer: No. It is for Firebase Hosting Classic and helps identify when App Hosting is a better fit.

faq.question: Can it deploy my site automatically?
faq.answer: It provides CLI guidance. Actual deployment still depends on user approval, Firebase authentication, and project access.

faq.question: What app types fit this skill?
faq.answer: Static sites, SPAs without SSR, and simple services behind Hosting rewrites fit this skill.

faq.question: Does it cover preview channels?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains preview channel deploys, expiration, and cloning a preview release to live.

faq.question: Can it configure redirects and headers?
faq.answer: Yes. It references Hosting configuration options for redirects, rewrites, headers, clean URLs, and trailing slash handling.

faq.question: Does it review application security?
faq.answer: No. It does not audit app code, IAM permissions, secrets, or production security policies.
